title: Sample data purge + Settings Data hub + product CSV export
summary: Owners can remove DEMO sample data under Settings → Data, then import/export Odoo product CSV. Overview excludes demo-seed orders after purge. Unit tests cover DEMO uuid prefix helpers.

purgeBehaviour.orders: kept in Odoo; Overview filters uuid demo-seed-{companyId}-% when sample_data_cleared_at set

caveats: Platform trial delete soft-deletes MySQL vendor only; Odoo company and DEMO rows may remain orphaned until ops cleanup.
Product CSV import does not set on-hand stock; owners must receive or adjust stock after import.
Paid demo pos.order rows are not hard-deleted.
postDeployAcceptance: Sign up trial with dummyData=true on a unique slug (isolated; do not use harbour/demo).
Overview shows sample banner; Settings → Data shows state=active and DEMO counts.
Admin types REMOVE SAMPLE → products/customers archived; banner gone; Overview KPIs exclude demo-seed orders.
Export CSV downloads active catalogue; Import via /products/odoo?import=1 still works.
Delete the trial tenant after UAT.

localChecks.note: Full Maven requires JDK 21. Prefer CI or a Java 21 host for OdooTenantProvisionerTest.
